title: Goals
description: The goal layer's typed goals (Plan 23 Task 13, spec section 8, P23-10): a goal source proposes one of these, the runner validates it (planner/goals.validate) and runs it under the instincts; each object's properties other than type are its dataclass's fields in planner/goals.py (P23-B).

oneOf.description: Scan each new place, then walk to the square (x, y); done on arrival.

y.description: The target square's world y in tiles.

oneOf.description: Loot the building's containers one use at a time (water, container, clothing, food, bandage, weapon: the order the loot takes them) until none is left.
